parts.label: (a)
parts.official_mark_scheme_text: Use the correct product rule or chain rule. M1. Obtain the correct derivative in any form, $\cos x\cos2x-2\sin x\sin2x$. A1. Equate the derivative to zero and use a correct double-angle formula. M1. Obtain an equation in one trigonometric variable. DM1; allow follow-through from coefficient errors in differentiation only. Obtain $6\sin^2x=1$, $6\cos^2x=5$ or $5\tan^2x=1$. A1. Obtain $x=0.421$ to 3 s.f. A1. Total 6.

parts.label: (b)
parts.official_mark_scheme_text: State or imply $du=-\sin x\,dx$. B1. Using a double-angle formula, express the integral in terms of $u$ and $du$; use $\cos2x=2\cos^2x-1$. M1. Integrate and obtain $\pm\left(u-\dfrac23u^3\right)$. A1. Use limits $u=1$ and $u=1/\sqrt2$ in an integral of the form $au+bu^3$, with $ab\ne0$; both limits must be substituted in both terms and decimals are not condoned. M1. Obtain $\dfrac13(\sqrt2-1)$ or a simplified equivalent. A1 ISW. Total 5.
